import html # Predefined template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = "

{title}

{body}
" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog entry for safe display on a webpage. Args: heading (str): The title of the blog post. content (str): The main text content of the blog post. Returns: str: A sanitized HTML string containing the formatted blog entry. """ # Escape any potentially dangerous characters to prevent XSS or # HTML injection. `html.escape` converts &, <, >, " and '. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Render the template with the sanitized values. formatted_entry = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_entry
